detaileddescription.para: Test that stub HSM initialization succeeds in development mode
Test that stub HSM is blocked in production mode without flag
Test that allow-stub-hsm flag allows stub in production (with warning)
Test periodic warning is empty with real HSM.
This test requires a real HSM library to be available. The path to the library must be provided via the THEMIS_REAL_HSM_LIBRARY environment variable. If the variable is not set, the test is skipped.
Test that periodic security check can be called safely
